case_title: HURMUSES PAUL VS GHARIB M. DBA TWIN PEAKS B.P.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY HURMUSES PAUL AS TO DEFENDANT GHARIB M. DBA TWIN PEAKS B.P. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-08-1993 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT GHARIB M. DBA TWIN PEAKS B.P.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HURMUSES PAUL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GHARIB M. DBA TWIN PEAKS B.P. COURT FINDS PLFT FAILED TO SUSTAIN HIS BURDEN OF PROVING DEF'S NEGLIGENCE TO PARTICULAR. THE COURT STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
